hooks.name: Conformity Review (post-change)
hooks.description: Review the completed change set against project standards once, at the end of a turn, instead of on every individual write. Deterministic checks (regions, tracking IDs, stack naming) are enforced in CI; the contributor-guide is always-on steering, so per-write prompting was redundant and slow.

action.prompt: Review any code changes made this turn against the standards in .kiro/steering/contributor-guide.md (naming, file location, shared utilities, shared scripts: check-prerequisites and deploy-cdk for every cdk deploy/bootstrap/destroy, platform-neutral cdk.json app command, CDK requirement, no hardcoded regions) and .kiro/steering/solution-adoption-tracking.md (tracking in the CDK app file, main stack only). If any change violates a standard, flag it and suggest the compliant fix. If everything conforms, say nothing.
